title: DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY!
text: DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY!. Look elsewhere!  These are terrible quality and don't work as they should.  They don't spin despite a strong flame and a drop of oil which was suggested for spinners that don't spin. Awful!  Don't waste your money like I did!
